name: AI Tech Watch — official feeds to fact-checked post ideas

parameters.content:
## 1. Triggers

A **daily schedule** at 07:00 Europe/Paris, plus a **manual** trigger for on-demand runs.

Both start the same fan-out: five official RSS/Atom feeds, fetched in parallel.

## 2. Official feeds, in parallel

OpenAI News, Google DeepMind, the Google AI Blog, the Hugging Face Blog, and arXiv cs.AI.

Each request **retries twice** and **continues on failure**. One broken feed must never wipe the digest.

URLs were checked live before being pinned here. There is no unofficial aggregator in this path.

## 3. Normalize, window, score

Canonicalize URLs, drop items older than **48 hours**, dedupe, then keyword-score.

Official blog posts in the window are kept. arXiv papers need a minimum score and are capped, so the digest stays readable.

## 4. LLM, with a safe fallback

If `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set, one OpenAI-compatible HTTP request extracts facts and a post angle as **JSON**.

The prompt forbids invented figures and requires the original `source_url`.

If the key is missing or the call fails, the workflow **still builds a digest** from source titles and snippets.

## 5. Validate, then write the digest

An idea is **rejected** if it has no known source URL, or if it uses a number that does not appear in the source text.

Accepted ideas still carry `needs_review: true`. This workflow never publishes.

## 6. Human review, optional notifications

The digest is the approval step: every idea is flagged **needs review**.

A Wait/form node is not used here, so a CLI run can finish. Add one later if you want in-app approval.

Slack, Gmail and Sheets sit behind `ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS=true` and use **placeholder credentials**. They stay off by default.

parameters.text: ={{ $json.markdown || 'AI Tech Watch digest is ready for review.' }}

parameters.subject: AI Tech Watch digest — needs review

parameters.content:
## 7. Error handler

In **Workflow Settings**, set *Error workflow* to this same workflow so the Error Trigger receives unhandled failures.

Feed and LLM nodes already continue on failure and degrade to a source-only digest. This path is for everything else.

It writes a short incident note. It never publishes.
